sql: select string_agg(status, ',' order by id) from anchor_receipts

select count(*) from anchor_receipts r join anchor_batches b on b.id = r.batch_id where r.status = 'da_nang_cap' and r.calendar = 'https://cal-b.test' and r.created_by = 'agent:anchor' and substr(r.receipt, 34, 32) = decode(b.manifest_sha256, 'hex') and position(decode('0588960d73d71901', 'hex') in r.receipt) > 0 and position(decode('83dfe30d2ef90c8e', 'hex') in r.receipt) = 0
